items.title: 6.6.2.2 Integration with Other Emerging Technologies (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of blockchain with AI and IoT (PDF 169-170).

items: AI aur blockchain: AI blockchain par rakha data, jis ki durustagi yaqeeni hai, jaanch kar privacy nuqsan kiye baghair nukte deta hai; maslan supply chain mein talab ka andaza aur logistics behtar karna.

IoT aur blockchain: IoT aalaat data chhed-chhaar se mehfooz ledger par darj karte hain; maslan khet mein mitti aur fasal ke sensors jin ki readings par bharosa ho, to kisan behtar faisle aur zyada paidawar karte hain.

blocks.prompt: AI ko blockchain se jorna data management ko kaise faida deta hai (MCQ 12)? Blockchain, AI aur IoT mil kar naye mauqe kaise banate hain (long question 7)?
blocks.explanation: (b) yeh data ki hifazat aur shaffafiyat barhata hai. IoT aalaat khud data jama karte, blockchain use qabil-e-aitbaar, chhed-chhaar se mehfooz mushtarak record banata, aur AI use jaanch kar andaza aur faisla karta hai. Mil kar, maslan, aisi supply chain banti hai jis mein sensors har marhala darj karein, sab is record par bharosa karein, aur AI talab ka andaza lagaye; ya aisa khet jahan sensors ka data aabpashi ki rehnumai kare aur khareedaron ko fasal ka maeyar saabit kare.

blocks.prompt: Class activity: blockchain ko AI ya IoT se jorne wala maqami project tajweez kijiye.
blocks.explanation: Maslan gaon mein doodh ki khareedari: IoT sensors har kisan ke doodh ki miqdar aur maeyar naapte, readings blockchain par jati hain ta ke adaigiyan munsifana aur na-qabil-e-tabdeel hon, aur AI dairy ke liye supply ka andaza lagata hai. Students masla, data aur faida pane wale pesh karein.

items: AI + blockchain: bharosemand data se nukte. IoT + blockchain: chhed-chhaar se mehfooz sensor records.
